selection.perf_private_runtime: every file/symlink in the pinned perf private library, lib/perf-core, and share/perf-core trees
selection.python_schema_runtime: complete non-pyc attr/attrs/jsonschema/jsonschema-specifications/referencing/rpds/idna/webcolors/typing-extensions package and dist-info trees
selection.python_stdlib: all .py/.so files under the pinned Python 3.12 stdlib, excluding site-packages and __pycache__
selection.rustc_host_manifest_runtime: the three toolchain-local rustc --version dependencies selected by ELF NEEDED/RUNPATH, excluding system DSOs
selection.valgrind_libexec: every file/symlink in the pinned Valgrind libexec/valgrind tree

system_boundary: The ELF interpreter, kernel, /proc and /sys interfaces, and system DSOs outside the pinned application roots are host-class dependencies. They are not individually content-pinned; host/kernel/topology/cgroup stability is captured and every wall result remains nonqualified and non-transferable.
